notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.emptyBody: Order updates, returns and delivery alerts will show up here.

push.label: Browser notifications on this device
push.hint: Get order and delivery alerts even when Souqly is closed.
push.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser settings to turn this on.

returns.title: Returns
returns.emptyBody: You can request a return from a delivered order within its return window.
returns.escalateBody: Our team will review this return with you and the seller.
returns.escalated: Dispute opened. We'll get back to you soon.
returns.escalatedBody: This return is under review by Souqly support.
returns.approvedBody: The seller approved your return. Please hand the items back as instructed by the seller.

form.title: Request a return
form.photosHint: Up to {{max}} photos, 5 MB each. Photos help the seller decide faster.
form.photoLimit: You can add up to {{max}} photos.
form.photoSize: Each photo must be 5 MB or smaller.
form.submitted: Return requested. The seller will respond soon.
form.policy: Refunds go to your Souqly wallet once the seller receives the items.
form.notEligibleBody: Only delivered orders within their return window can be returned.

seller.title: Returns
seller.subtitle: Review return requests, receive items back and refund buyers.
seller.emptyBody: Return requests from buyers will appear here.
seller.escalated: The buyer escalated this return. Souqly support will contact you.
seller.receivedBody: Confirm the items are back with you. Stock will be restocked.
seller.refundBody: {{amount}} will be credited to the buyer's Souqly wallet. This can't be undone.

rider.handOverHint: Cash to hand over to your store: {{amount}}
rider.started: Delivery started. Sharing your live location.
rider.emptyBody: New deliveries assigned to you will show up here.

location.deniedBody: The customer can't see you on the map. Turn on location to share it:
location.step1: Tap the lock or info icon next to the address bar.

deliver.title: Hand over the order
deliver.codeHint: Ask the customer for the code shown in their order.

deliver.photoHint: Optional: a photo of the parcel at the door.

cash.title: Cash in hand

earnings.title: Earnings
earnings.note: Earnings are paid by each store as agreed with you.

notRider.body: The rider app is for delivery staff of Souqly stores. Ask a store owner to add you as a rider from their Staff page.

seller.subtitle: Your delivery team, the cash they hold and what they earn.

seller.amountInvalid: Enter an amount up to the outstanding cash.
seller.feeHint: What each rider earns per completed delivery.
